parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the service provider.

parameters.name: MethodController
parameters.description: The full name of the Controller class to which the interface belongs.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The request path that corresponds to the interface.

parameters.name: ServiceGroup
parameters.description: The group to which the service belongs.
